scenarios.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the right

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
chooses Dock to Right from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser remains on the left of the viewport
the user opens Docking Positions from the active ribbon tab
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
